items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: There was Sidney Dazman, Eugene Ware and I. Three trumpets

ctx.x: And the, well I'll start from the trumpet section. There was Sidney Dazman, Eugene Ware and I. Three trumpets, Lewis Nelson was on trombone. And I go from the sax section. There was Earl Bostic and there was Eugene Hall. He's playing, I think he's still living in San Diego. And there was, I had three saxophones and, oh yeah, Gishard. A little Gishard. How do you spell that name? G-I-S-S-E-R-D Gishard.
And his first name? What was his first name? He said Little. It must have been a little and a big one.
